description: Quality assurance for AI-generated images against original prompts.

configurable_values.agent_role: Quality Assurance Specialist for AI Imagery
evaluation_steps: Prompt Fidelity: Does the image show what was asked?
Realism/Style Adherence: Does the style match the requested art direction?
Anatomy & Physics: Check for hands, limbs, gravity, reflections.
Artifacts: Check for glitching, random floating objects, garbled text.
critical_fail_conditions: Extra or missing limbs on humans/animals
Severe facial distortion (unless specified as horror)
Visible text/watermarks when none were requested

output_format.missing_elements: List of prompt details missing from image
